clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: EY首席：美联储今年将按兵不动
title_lines: 美联储今年将按兵不动
title_highlights: 美联储今年将按兵不动

subtitles.en: I think the dissent, but I think the Fed does not move. I think the Fed is going to be on hold through the rest of the year.
subtitles.zh: 我认为会有异议，但美联储不会行动。今年剩余时间美联储将按兵不动。

subtitles.en: The reason being that if you look at the inflation developments even though patience is running thin amongst all on the committee, you are in this environment where you have some disinflationary currents that
subtitles.zh: 原因是，尽管委员会内部耐心渐失，但通胀形势仍存在一些通缩力量，这些力量可能持续到年底。

subtitles.en: are likely to carry the way through the end of the year. Terror pressures are past their peak.
You're seeing still the effect that passed through of lower energy prices, even though we've seen this re-acceleration in oil prices and gasoline prices,
subtitles.zh: 尽管油价和汽油价格重新加速，但能源价格下降的传导效应仍在，仍有通缩影响。

subtitles.en: but there's still a disinflationary effect there. And then very importantly, the labor market is not inflationary.
subtitles.zh: 而且非常重要的是，劳动力市场不具有通胀性。

subtitles.en: Wage growth is still trending down towards 3.5%.
subtitles.zh: 薪资增长仍呈下降趋势，接近3.5%。

subtitles.en: That's not inflationary. That should not be a source of inflation going forward.
subtitles.zh: 这并非通胀性，不应成为未来通胀的来源。

subtitles.en: There are risks, however. And I think that's very important to keep in mind.
subtitles.zh: 然而，风险依然存在，这一点非常重要。

subtitles.en: September very much a live meeting. And the next meetings after that, October and November and December, will also be live meetings.
subtitles.zh: 9月会议非常关键，之后的10月、11月和12月会议也同样关键。

subtitles.en: But I think the Fed will eventually end up on the side of not tightening monetary policy.
subtitles.zh: 但我认为美联储最终不会收紧货币政策。

subtitles.en: Do you think if we get those dissents that they compromise the leadership of the new Fed share?
subtitles.zh: 如果出现异议票，是否会削弱新美联储主席的领导力？

subtitles.en: Or do they actually do them a little bit of a favor through the summer? I think that's very important to keep in mind.
subtitles.zh: 还是说，这反而在夏季帮了他们一把？这一点很重要。
en_highlights: do them a little bit of a favor

subtitles.en: Because during his testimony, two days of testimony, he said a lot, but very little in terms of his views on inflation, his views on monetary policy.
subtitles.zh: 因为在两天的听证会上，他说了很多，但关于通胀和货币政策的观点却很少。
en_highlights: views on inflation, his views on monetary policy

subtitles.en: He was cryptic at best. He did not say whether inflation was this number or that number, which for a Fed share, you would expect at least to express one view of a number,
subtitles.zh: 他非常含糊，没有明确通胀的具体数字，而作为美联储主席，至少应该表达一个数字观点。
en_highlights: express one view of a number

subtitles.en: a gauge of inflation. He did not express any views as to whether he thought there was disinflation in the pipeline.
subtitles.zh: 他也没有表达是否认为通胀正在放缓。

clip_research.source_claim: I think the Fed is going to be on hold through the rest of the year.
clip_research.public_baseline: EY's official forecast for 2024 included expectations of rate cuts earlier in the year; Daco himself had previously pushed back rate cut expectations to June 2024.
clip_research.surprise_gap: Daco's current claim that the Fed will be on hold for the rest of the year contrasts with earlier EY forecasts that anticipated rate cuts in 2024.

position_change.prior_position: Daco previously expected 75bps of rate cuts in 2024 (from 100bps earlier) with first cut in June 2024.
position_change.current_position: Daco now says Fed will be on hold for the rest of the year, implying no rate cuts in 2024.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
